edges.subject: Pompe disease
edges.quote: five LSDs resulting from defective proteins that govern widely different lysosomal functions including glycogen degradation (Pompe)

edges.subject: Cystinosis
edges.quote: five LSDs resulting from defective proteins that govern widely different lysosomal functions including glycogen degradation (Pompe), lysosomal transport (Cystinosis)

edges.subject: Danon disease
edges.quote: five LSDs resulting from defective proteins that govern widely different lysosomal functions including glycogen degradation (Pompe), lysosomal transport (Cystinosis), lysosomal trafficking (Danon)

edges.subject: Gaucher disease
edges.quote: five LSDs resulting from defective proteins that govern widely different lysosomal functions including glycogen degradation (Pompe), lysosomal transport (Cystinosis), lysosomal trafficking (Danon), glycolipid degradation (Gaucher)

edges.subject: Batten disease
edges.quote: five LSDs resulting from defective proteins that govern widely different lysosomal functions including glycogen degradation (Pompe), lysosomal transport (Cystinosis), lysosomal trafficking (Danon), glycolipid degradation (Gaucher) and an unidentified function (Batten)
